question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Break a leg
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Break a leg"** means to wish someone good luck, especially in a performance or presentation. (शुभकामनाएं देना)

 
 
• **Example: **Before the play, all the actors told each other to **break a leg.**
 
 
 
• **"Wish good luck"** means to express hope that someone will succeed. (शुभकामनाएं देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She **wished her friend good luck** before the big exam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Wish good luck.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hurt yourself** (खुद को चोट पहुँचाना): To cause physical harm to oneself.

 
 
• **Example:** Be careful with that knife, you might** hurt yourself.**
 
 
 
• **Wish bad luck** (बुरी किस्मत की कामना करना): To hope that something bad happens to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** It’s not good to **wish bad luck** on others.
 
 
 
• **Sprain a leg** (पैर में मोच आना): To injure a leg by twisting it suddenly.
 
 
• **Example:** He **sprained his leg** while playing football.
